result.title: SafeDiSTL: Decomposing Joint Constraints for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Cooperative multi-agent tasks often impose constraints on a shared objective or collective safety. A team level violation cost function can measure this constraint outcome, but does not distinguish which agents' actions most strongly influence that violation. We present SafeDiSTL, a constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that allows for credit assignment even with joint constraint measurements. We use Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness to measure episode-level violation through running-maximum cost increments. Smooth full-episode robustness and differentiable dynamics provide action sensitivities, which allocate each cost increment across agents at the same decision time. These sensitivities account for delayed effects when weighting agents' shares of each cost increment. We study the framework in cooperative payload transport, connected navigation, and networked traffic control tasks. SafeDiSTL achieves 1.6-5.1x the safe-success rate in transport, improves navigation safe-success by 11.1%, and delivers 50-68% more throughput in traffic when compared to constrained baselines. Results demonstrate a strong improvement of the learned policy in dealing with shared constraint while retaining the performance of unconstrained policies.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SafeDiSTL：用 STL 鲁棒度与可微动力学得到的动作敏感度，把团队级约束违反成本按决策时刻分解到各智能体，在联合约束测量下实现信用分配，并在多智能体任务上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽不涉及视觉输入或 latent 推理，但其用可微敏感度把联合约束成本分摊到各智能体与各时刻的做法，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中跨推理步、并行状态的贡献分配与监督提供可供核查的方法线索。
